title: 200 Indonesian Learner Personas for Nugget Nihongo — v6
created_for: Persona-led usability, content quality, product fit and regression testing through Google Antigravity
important_caveat: All profiles are synthetic; feedback and reactions are hypotheses to test, not real user statements. Data-quality findings must be based on content evidence, not assumed from the personas.
